king.notes: Full secular loop: titles, vassals, war at Calais, events, plague, church standing.

duke.notes: Vassal of France. Levy, events, and Norman lands. Diplomacy kernel is still a stub.

count.notes: County of Salon under Naples/Provence. Closest to the vertical-slice loop.

minor_lord.notes: Barony only. Events are local. No independent realm cache worth a crown.

bishop.notes: Archbishop of Aix, no secular title. Church, events, and plague. Army raise uses the see's town levy, not a feudal host.

prince_bishop.notes: Duchy of Westphalia plus Archbishop of Cologne. Dual authority is live.

holy_order.notes: Grand Master at Rhodes. Order tables, levy, and events work. The order is not a realm. Fleet and crusade missions are not a playable loop yet.
